Write a complete, self-contained, runnable vanilla JavaScript action game-systems module — separate classes that communicate without shared globals, ending in a small self-checking demo that asserts the behaviour. Action collision: a SpatialHash that buckets entities into grid cells so only nearby pairs are tested (broad phase), plus an axis-aligned bounding-box overlap test (narrow phase).
